evidence_quotes.O: I took some shots in a museum under very bad lighting and a 3 second exposures, came out great with this monopod.
evidence_quotes.C: Problem: It's the receiver that is charged (recharged) not the transmitter. The transmitter uses an A-23 battery.
evidence_quotes.E: These people need to wake up to reality. This is the best compact digital camera in this price range.... PERIOD.
evidence_quotes.A: The guy with issues on installation should have looked at where his antenna was located first before buying and item that won't fit in the space available.
evidence_quotes.N: This lens is a tiny bit soft at 300 (480 on my XTi) but it has never been an issue.
